context: DeskBird room-booking workflow; intended audience: office coordinators.

source_items.item: Customer email says booking confusion decreased in April.
Internal note says confusion was unchanged.
Metric, baseline, interviewee role, evidence record, attribution choice, and quotation permission.

core_questions: How did room booking work before and during April?
What types of confusion occurred, for whom, and in which situations?
What, if anything, changed in the workflow or user experience?
Were there cases where confusion stayed the same or increased?
fact_confirmations: Can you confirm whether confusion decreased, stayed unchanged, or varied by user or situation?
What dates, population, baseline, and measure support your account?
How should the customer email and internal note be reconciled?
permission_prompts: If a statement is considered for quotation, may its wording and attribution be submitted for later written approval?
What role, organization name, editing boundaries, and publication channels would be acceptable if approval is granted?

evidence_requests.request: Provide the customer email and internal note, with dates and context, for comparison.
Request any available confusion measure, baseline, or user feedback record.

unresolved: No metric, baseline, interviewee role, evidence record, attribution choice, or quotation permission is supplied.
Pricing is outside the approved topics and should not be asked about.
